evidence: DHCP clients receive addresses but cannot reach off-subnet resources.
R18 show running-config output shows DHCP pool FINANCE defines default-router 192.168.170.254.
R18 show ip interface brief output shows Gi0/2 is configured with 192.168.170.1.
root_cause: The DHCP pool FINANCE advertises an incorrect default router 192.168.170.254 instead of the active gateway 192.168.170.1.
verification: Run show running-config on R18 to confirm the DHCP pool FINANCE default-router is set to 192.168.170.1.
Renew the DHCP lease on a client and verify it receives the correct default gateway.
Test off-subnet reachability from a DHCP client.
fix_steps: Enter the DHCP pool configuration mode for FINANCE.
Update the default-router option to the active gateway address 192.168.170.1.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: DHCP pool FINANCE advertises default-router 192.168.170.254 instead of active gateway 192.168.170.1.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Update default-router option in DHCP pool FINANCE to 192.168.170.1.
